data.reason: The triage could see no evidence for: A ticket that changes an agent action, touches billing or the policy gate, or carries a migration gets full depth by rule with Jev not asked, proven with a fixture; In shadow mode the reviewer still reads everything and the triage record stores what would have been excluded; kpi.json carries the reviewer's output tokens and the excluded share of the diff. A criterion with nothing behind it is answered at the tdd stage, by writing the test or the check that proves it, rather than by a reviewer reading a diff that does not contain it
